name: Kite shield
description: Long, tapering and painted with a device nobody remembers. Covers the left leg all the way to the boot.
notes: A medium shield, heavier than the 3 kg wooden shield. Blocks as the wood-shield profile (no separate shield data yet). Weight 4 kg. Catalogue tier common (economy doc, medium class 70-120). The economy doc has no shield band; priced as a helmet of the matching class. Authored for shop stock (mw-ju8.3); not for sale until a shop row stocks it (mw-ju8.5).
